entry.title: New: dsh-mcp-view
entry.summary: MCP servers & tools inventory panel: one-click floating panel from the sidebar that lists every MCP server and tool (transport, endpoint, JSON schema, last-used time), grouped by server, collapsed by default, with live search and refresh; last-used times come from real session logs. Exact install spec: dsh-mcp-view. Source event: beancookie/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
